meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Indian skin tone par **white cast na chhodne ke liye chemical ya hybrid sunscreen** choose karein—mineral sunscreens mein zinc oxide/titanium dioxide ke kaaran cast dikh sakta hai.[1][2]

**Best overall pick:** **Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++**  
- Lightweight, generally no white cast  
- Fragrance-free; daily use ke liye achha option  
- Oily/combination skin par comfortable finish[3]

**Skin type ke hisaab se alternatives:**
- **Oily skin:** Neutrogena Ultra Sheer SPF 50+—lightweight aur water-resistant, lekin alcohol ki wajah se very dry/sensitive skin ko irritate kar sakta hai.[4]
- **Dry/normal skin:** Plum SPF 50 PA++++—lightweight, no-white-cast formula.[5]
- **Sensitive skin:** Fragrance-free **hybrid sunscreen** try karein; pehle jawline par patch test karein.
- **Tinted option:** Lakmé Sun Expert Tinted SPF 50—tint ki wajah se white cast kam hota hai aur Indian skin tones par blend hota hai.[6]

**Kaise lagayein:** Face aur neck ke liye lagbhag **do-finger amount**, subah skincare ke baad; bahar rehne, sweating ya swimming ke baad reapply karein. Pehle 2–3 din patch test zaroor karein.
